words.def: how right or appropriate something is for a particular need or purpose.
words.book: We recently discovered your ___ and are interested in gathering more information to help us evaluate its suitability for our needs.
uses: Before we order, we need to confirm the suitability of the batteries for high-temperature sites.
can you check the suitability of this VFD for a 75 kW pump?
Our engineer will assess the site's suitability for rooftop solar.
dont: We want to know if it is suitable or no suitable for us.
doo: We'd like to evaluate its suitability for our needs.

words.def: a large quantity — buying lots of the same item, usually at a lower price.
words.book: 2. Pricing details, including any available discounts, packages or special offers for bulk purchases.
uses: We can offer an 8% discount on bulk orders of 100 batteries or more.
do we have bulk pricing for 12V 100Ah?
If they buy in bulk, we can absorb the shipping cost.
dont: If you buy a big amount together, we make you discount.
doo: We offer a discount for bulk purchases.

words.def: the period of time in which something is planned to happen.
words.book: 3. Estimated delivery or implementation time frames, as well as any associated shipping or set-up costs.
uses: Could you confirm the delivery time frame for the 200 kVA UPS?
what's the time frame for the install?
The time frame for commissioning is three weeks from delivery.
dont: What is the time the delivery will take it?

words.def: a written promise to repair or replace a product if it fails within a certain period.
words.book: 4. Information regarding warranty, support and maintenance services, if applicable.
uses: All inverters come with a five-year manufacturer's warranty.
is this unit still under warranty?
The failure isn't covered by the warranty because the room had no AC.
dont: The UPS is inside the guarantee.
doo: The UPS is still under warranty.

words.def: the energy or progress that keeps something moving forward.
words.book: To keep the momentum going, I would like to propose the following next steps: ___.
uses: To keep the momentum going, I've attached a draft schedule for the site survey.
great meeting today — let's keep the momentum 💪
We lost momentum on this tender when the client changed the specs.
dont: Let's continue the hot of the meeting.

words.def: to continue with something, or to go ahead and start it.
words.book: If you have any questions or wish to proceed, feel free to contact me at ___.
uses: Once we receive the signed PO, we'll proceed with the order.
Shall we proceed with the installation next week?
dont: If you are okay, we will go on the order.
doo: If you're happy with the quote, we'll proceed with the order.

upgrade.plain: I want the price of the UPS.
pro: I want the price of the UPS quickly.
Could you kindly send us a quotation for the UPS?
upgrade.why: ‎I want‎ ناشفة في الإيميل؛ ‎Could you kindly …‎ أشيك.

upgrade.plain: I am Ahmed from company ABC for UPS.
upgrade.ar: أنا أحمد من شركة ABC للـ UPS
pro: My name is Ahmed, and I'm an account manager at ABC Power Solutions.
I am Ahmed from company ABC for UPS.
upgrade.why: عرّف نفسك بالاسم والوظيفة والشركة: ‎My name is … and I'm … at …‎.
‎Please find … attached‎ هي الصيغة الطبيعية النهارده.

upgrade.plain: I want to follow our meeting.
pro: I want to follow our meeting.
I follow you about the meeting.
I wanted to follow up on our meeting last Tuesday.
upgrade.why: ‎follow up on‎ = تتابع؛ ‎follow‎ لوحدها معناها تمشي ورا حد.

upgrade.plain: If you agree, we will begin to make the order.
pro: If you agree, we begin to make the order.
If you're happy to proceed, we'll place the order.
If agree, order will be make.
upgrade.why: ‎place an order‎ و ‎proceed‎ هما الكلمات المستخدمة في المبيعات.

upgrade.plain: Your offer maybe good together with us.
upgrade.ar: ممكن نشتغل مع بعض وتبقى حاجة كويسة
pro: I believe there may be potential synergies between our companies.
Your offer maybe good together with us.
We can make together good things maybe.
upgrade.why: ‎potential synergies‎ = فرصة تعاون تفيد الطرفين، بصيغة مهنية.
